Name: tiun.
Tagline: Auth, billing, and payments for AI builders
Description: One system for auth, payments, customer data, and analytics. One command to install. Launch a paid product the same day you start building.

Name: Voiskey
Tagline: AI voice typing that sounds right in every app
Description: Voiskey starts from what you meant, not just what you said. Speak a rough thought and it comes back shaped for where it's going and who's reading it: casual with a friend, composed with a colleague, technical with an AI. It arrives 5x faster than typing, cleaned up and ready to send, while you still sound like you. Voiskey is now available on iOS, macOS, Android, and Windows, in over 100 languages. It's free to start. Join during launch and get a free month of Pro.

Name: Axari
Tagline: Assign your security busywork to your AI twin
Description: Your Axari AI twin understands your security world, works across your tools and teams, and keeps work moving until it is actually done. Assign it a goal, let it work proactively, or give it recurring responsibilities – all from within Slack or MS Teams. Attackers aren't going to use less AI, neither should you. You + your AI twin = indefatigable.

Name: Anthropologic
Tagline: The zero distance consumer research platform.
Description: Traditional research is deep but slow. Social listening is fast but shallow. LLMs are fluent but culturally blind. Anthropologic reads the whole internet through our 'Human Context Protocol' to uncover consumer, category and cultural truths. Nine workflows, 239 markets, 100+ languages. Research, innovation and foresight answers in minutes.

Name: siift
Tagline: Turn AI noise into better business decisions
Description: Building a business with AI can quickly become a mess of chats, tools, ideas, and conflicting advice. siift turns that noise into a living map of your business, connecting strategy, evidence, decisions, and results in one place. From validation and build strategy to GTM and growth, our AI uses your evolving business context and proven processes to challenge assumptions, identify risks, and help you focus on what matters next.

Name: Kilo Code for iOS and Android
Tagline: Start coding agents, control sessions, review PRs. Anywhere.
Description: Run Cloud Agents, control VS Code and CLI sessions, review Pull Requests, and respond to coding agents from your iPhone, iPad, or Android.

Name: OpenAI Agents API
Tagline: Cloud agents, run on OpenAI's Codex harness
Description: OpenAI's managed version of the Codex harness to build cloud agents with one API call instead of your own orchestration. Handles long sessions, smart tool use, and subagents working in parallel. Runs on OpenAI or partner sandboxes. No extra fees beyond token and tool usage. Open source harness, public beta now.

Name: Buddy AI Access (MCP)
Tagline: Your agent needs more than your repo
Description: Give AI agents secure access to your infrastructure and workflow. With Buddy MCP agents can run pipelines, inspect logs, deploy apps, create sandboxes, publish artifacts and manage domains. Control exactly what they can access with workspace permissions and tool scopes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and other MCP clients.

Name: PeekPaste
Tagline: Your clipboard, within reach
Description: PeekPaste is a native clipboard manager for Mac that stays out of your way until you need it. Push your pointer against the screen edge and your clipboard slides in. Find text, code, links, images, colors and files, search inside screenshots with on-device OCR, pin and organize clips, or open the full Library when you need more. Everything stays on your Mac - no accounts, analytics, telemetry or cloud clipboard service.

Name: The Minimalist Entrepreneur Skills
Tagline: Book playbook as Claude Code slash skills
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: The Minimalist Entrepreneur as 10 open-source Claude Code skills by Sahil Lavingia. Install the plugin, then run slash commands like /validate-idea, /mvp, /pricing, and /minimalist-review to apply the book to your own business. Free and MIT-licensed on GitHub.

Name: Mac Duo
Tagline: Turn your display into frosted glass as you close the lid
Topics: Mac, User Experience, Menu Bar Apps
Description: A macOS app that turns your display into frosted glass as you close the lid. Driven by the hinge sensor, so it moves at the speed of your hand.

Name: Idlen
Tagline: Earn while you work with AI in any IDE or browser
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Advertising, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Developers wait on AI all day. That wait is an ad slot. One network, three doors. If you code: install the VS Code, Cursor or Chrome extension. A native ad while the model thinks. You keep 70%. We don't read your prompts. If you sell a developer tool: you show up in the IDE and the browser, targeted by the stack they actually use (React, Python, AWS). Pay €200, get €400 this week. If you shipped a chat app: npm i @idlen/chat-sdk. Three lines. Ads optional. No key, no ads. You keep 70%.

Name: Proofrr
Tagline: One workspace for creative feedback, reviews, and approvals
Description: Feedback in WhatsApp. Versions in Drive. Approvals lost in email. The review process eats into the actual work. Proofrr is one workspace for creative projects, client feedback, and version control. ✓ Project management for design & video workflows ✓ Side-by-side draft comparison ✓ Annotations & threaded comments ✓ Shareable review links — no client login needed ✓ AI-assisted reviews to speed up feedback

Name: Tangerine
Tagline: Offline file modifier for Mac
Description: Tangerine is a Mac app for converting files simply with Shift-drag. Hold Option for advanced tools. Convert and compress images, videos, audio, PDFs, and archives, remove metadata, redact documents, and annotate photos. All locally, without uploading your files.

Name: Narrative
Tagline: AI-first video editor, just describe edits & refine in chat
Description: Narrative brings video editing, custom motion graphics, and reference-video style matching into one interface. Upload your footage, describe your edit, and keep refining through chat. Add music, sound effects, and transitions, or get inspiration from reference videos. From podcast clips to launch videos, create without learning Premiere or After Effects. We handle rendering and storage. Our launch video was made entirely in Narrative.

Name: DynamicLake 2.0
Tagline: Mac, Dynamic Island, apple, Mac apps
Description: DynamicLake - Dynamic Island for Mac · Plugins · Notifications · Drag and drop · Converter · Calls · Airdrop · Timer · and more

Name: FATHER
Tagline: A Mac dashboard for site traffic, deploys, uptime, and SEO
Description: A mission-control dashboard for teams shipping on Vercel. Connect your account and every project fills in live: traffic, deploys, uptime, and PageSpeed scores. Search Console and Bing show clicks, rankings, and indexing. SSL and domain renewals get a countdown, and failing GitHub checks get flagged. When a build fails, the menu-bar F turns red and a notification fires, even with the window closed, so you know a site's down before your clients do. Tokens stay on your Mac. One-time purchase.

Name: Multimodal Agents by Sierra
Tagline: AI agents that switch between voice, text, and visuals
Description: Sierra's multimodal agents bring voice, text, and visuals into the same customer conversation. Voice is for explaining what you need, a visual for comparing options side by side, and text for referencing something later. Instead of picking just one, the agent automatically shifts between modes as the conversation needs.

Name: Payflip
Tagline: Pay anyone you can name. No IBAN, no wallet address.
Description: Payflip is a dollar wallet with usernames. Send USDC or USDT to an email, @handle, phone or QR. The recipient picks how to receive, and if they don't claim it, the money comes back to you. Non-custodial. Fee shown before you send.

Name: Thoughts for Mac
Tagline: Capture notes from your menubar using text, images or voice
Description: Thoughts is a menubar app for your Mac which helps you keep notes quickly using text, images and voice. Add your favorite agent API key and it'll also help transcribe audio, context images to text and help do simple text-tranforms like capitalization, translations and spelling fixes. Think of it as a fun small multi-tool for your menubar.
